summary.text: Robert Menendez Jr. is the Democratic incumbent for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District, first elected in 2022 and sworn in in January 2023.

An attorney raised in Union City, he previously served on the Hudson School Board of Trustees and as a commissioner of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey. He serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee and is Vice Chair of Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Menendez was born in Englewood, New Jersey, and, according to his official biography, was raised in Union City as the grandson of Cuban immigrants.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2008 and a J.D. from Rutgers University Law School in 2011.
He worked as an attorney, including at the law firm Lowenstein Sandler LLP, according to his official biography, and served on the Hudson School Board of Trustees.

Menendez later served as a commissioner of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, where, according to his office, he chaired the Governance and Ethics Committee and sat on the Finance Committee.
He was first elected to the U.S. House in 2022 and sworn in on January 3, 2023, representing most of Hudson County, the East and North Wards of Newark, and the City of Elizabeth.

In his second term, Menendez serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee and its Energy, Environment, and Communications and Technology subcommittees; earlier in the 118th Congress he served on the Homeland Security and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
According to his official biography, he is also Vice Chair of Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus and a Regional Whip for the House Democratic Caucus.
